subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: After the deletion race is fixed, should OpenClaw adopt this experimental core Claws status/remove lifecycle and persisted ownership contract as part of RFC 0016?
rationale: This protected draft adds a destructive core command and persistent lifecycle semantics while the RFC remains open.

options.title: Sponsor after safe deletion
options.body: Approve this lifecycle slice once identity-pinned removal and stack-level state-contract review are complete.

options.title: Land read-only status
options.body: Keep lifecycle inspection while deferring destructive removal and provenance-release semantics.

options.title: Pause the RFC stack
options.body: Do not merge this slice until the broader Claws direction is explicitly accepted or redirected.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after safe deletion
recommendation.body: Approve this lifecycle slice once identity-pinned removal and stack-level state-contract review are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the detailed RFC and stacked implementation history and are best positioned to coordinate the product decision with repository maintainers.
